hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored autocorrelation reproduces statsmodels.tsa.acf (adjusted=FALSE, the biased/demeaned estimator) BIT-FOR-BIT across lags; the lag-0 value is exactly 1; and the ACF decays to below 1/e within a few lags (a short decorrelation time for a broadband EEG segment).

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: autocorrelation equals statsmodels.tsa.acf to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) across lags
